articles.title: U.S. strikes Iran before Hormuz Strait blockade restarts

articles.title: Oil prices rise as U.S. launches new Iran airstrikes, while Trump abandons Strait of Hormuz fee

articles.title: US President Trump drops 20% Strait of Hormuz fee plan

articles.title: Sudan faces escalating hunger crisis due to war and Hormuz disruption – WFP

articles.title: Murder of UK politician Ann Widdecombe was ‘targeted attack’, police say

articles.title: Australian police reveal unseen photos 25 years after British backpacker murder

articles.title: US judge voids Donald Trump's $1.8bn settlement with IRS that gave him immunity from tax audits
